title: recomp-achievements set
description: One achievement set for a static recompilation (recomp-achievements/1). See docs/json-format.md.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

schema.description: Format version. Optional; files without it are read as version 1.

id.description: Unique set id; prefixes every achievement key ("<set id>:<achievement id>"). Defaults to the file name without .achievements.json.

title.description: Display name. Defaults to the id.

platform.description: Where the list came from; picks the default popup style and how platform_id is read.

category.description: Default category for achievements that don't set one.

points_cap.description: When the points add up to more than this, they are scaled down to exactly this total. 0: no cap.

points_total.description: The points are scaled up or down to exactly this total, e.g. 1000. Beats points_cap. 0: off.

enabled.description: Whether the set counts until the player turns it on or off in the achievement settings. Off: it can't unlock and its points are hidden until turned on.

source.description: Free-form provenance: game id, URL, export date, tool.

id.description: Unique within the set. Saves are keyed by "<set id>:<id>", so keep it stable. Defaults to platform_id.

platform_id.description: XDBF achievement id, trophy id or RetroAchievements id. 0: none.

locked_description.description: Shown while locked instead of the description (e.g. for secret achievements).

display_order.description: Sort key within the set. Defaults to the position in the file.

icon.description: Path relative to this file, or "xdbf:<image id>", "trophy:<file>", "ra:<badge>".

legacy_keys.description: Older save keys to read progress from when the current key isn't saved yet.

checklist.description: Items for a checklist trigger, in display order.

trigger.description: How the achievement unlocks. A string is shorthand for {"type": <string>}. Omitted: manual.

type.description: manual, stat, event, checklist, count, memory, or a game-defined type. When omitted it is inferred: stat if "stat" is set, memory if "condition" is, checklist or event if "event" is, else manual.

stat.description: stat: the stat name passed to ReportStat().

event.description: event, checklist, count: the event name passed to ReportEvent().

target.description: event, count: only reports with this target count. Empty or "any": every target.

threshold.description: stat: value to reach. count: how many targets or occurrences.

distinct.description: count: count distinct targets (true) or every occurrence (false).

progress_bar.description: false hides the progress bar the UI would otherwise show.

params.description: Extra values for game-defined triggers; merged with any unknown fields.
